# Air To Share

> Instant file and text sharing between devices on the same network - no registration required.

Air To Share is a simple, fast, and private way to share files and text between your devices. Works on any device with a web browser - phones, tablets, laptops, or desktops.

## Features

- **Instant File Sharing**: Upload and share files across devices instantly
- **Text Sharing**: Share text snippets and notes between devices
- **QR Code Access**: Scan QR code to quickly access shared content on mobile
- **No Registration**: Start sharing immediately without creating an account
- **Privacy First**: Files are stored temporarily and auto-deleted
- **Cross-Platform**: Works on any device with a modern web browser
- **One-Time Downloads**: Option for secure one-time file downloads

## Pages

- [Home](https://airtoshare.app/): Main file and text sharing interface
- [How It Works](https://airtoshare.app/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide on using Air To Share
- [FAQ](https://airtoshare.app/faq): Frequently asked questions
- [Feedback](https://airtoshare.app/feedback): Submit feedback and suggestions
- [Blog](https://airtoshare.app/blog): Tips, updates, and articles about file sharing

## Technology Stack

- **Backend**: Laravel (PHP)
- **Frontend**: Blade Templates, JavaScript
- **Storage**: Local file system with auto-cleanup
- **Features**: Progressive Web App (PWA) support

## How It Works

1. Open Air To Share on your devices
2. Devices on the same network are automatically connected via IP
3. Upload files or enter text to share
4. Access shared content on any connected device
5. Scan QR code for quick mobile access
6. Files are automatically cleaned up after expiry
